checkpoint.summary: Change 017 execution-strategy loop integration is complete and machine-qualified on this machine. Authoring the production-loop qualifications surfaced and fixed six real integration bugs (non-durable dispatch strategy selection, SWARM-labeled DAG starts, dead completion bridge, missing result-manifest directory, stale-dependency skip on DAG resume, Windows rev-list range quirk silently emptying worker filesChanged). Change 017 is folded into openspec/specs/execution-strategy-loop-integration/.
